payload.claim: The module docstring's operational warning ("Not safe beside PACKAGE's re-verification. Its network takes `DEFAULT_SUBNET`, which that re-verification also creates on, so whichever starts second fails at `create_network`.") names `DEFAULT_SUBNET`, a symbol this diff deletes from `saffron/cell/runtime.py` entirely, and states a present-tense claim about current system behavior that this same diff makes false: `reverify`'s two gate-only cells (`saffron/phases/package.py`) no longer create on `10.88.0.0/24` at all — they now claim a /24 of `SUBNETS["pool"]` (`10.200.0.0/16`) with `allocate_network`, a disjoint range, so the described collision at `create_network` can no longer occur. The diff edits this file's two call sites (lines 60 and 64) to hardcode `"10.88.0.0/24"` but leaves the compatibility warning referring to a name that exists nowhere else in the tree and describing a failure mode the diff itself just removed.
